title: Intimate tour led by charming and professional people.
text: The receptionist on duty today at 11:15 AM, with incredible kindness, exceptional dedication, and exemplary professionalism, is worth the visit all by herself because she allows visitors to start the experience under the best possible conditions. Next to Gaudí's Casa Batlló, this house with its unique design is even more impressive. The guided tour is fun, and the guide was also particularly smiling and kind. Nothing like the employees at Gaudí's houses, who are almost all jaded and inhospitable. Nothing like that here: an intimate tour led by charming people. Highly recommended without hesita
author: erictK7837JA

title: Very nice home and the opportunity to taste their chocolate
text: Very pleasant visit with audio guide but in the presence of a person who directs us from room to room. Only regret not the time to look at the details because we follow from room to room as soon as the explanation of the audio guide is finished. 1 to 2 minutes free would be useful to observe the details and take the time to stop in the corridors to admire the paintings or other decorations. The possibility to enjoy a cup of hot chocolate in the dining area is appreciable as well as the shop for chocolate purchases.
author: denisbJ7583UP

title: Don’t know why this is not more popular - brilliant experience!
text: We did English guided tour at 10am and we were only 2 visitors! Cant believe why this is not more popular. The house is amazing and very interesting story of the Amatller family and their life. Very knowledgable and friendly staff. Finished off with a small box of chocolates included in the price and cup of melted hot chocolate - delicious!
author: SamanthaTyson8

title: It's worth it!
text: I had read other reviews and decided to go see this house. I did not have to make Reservation online, we arrived at 10 am and were the first to pass. A Guide was always with us (I think his name is Luis, if I remember correctly, very gentle) and handled the audio guides we had. Personally I was impressed with the beauty of this house and especially the story she tells. My children aged 10 and 12 also liked saying that the memory they will have of Barcelona will be the Sagrada Familia and the Amatller house.
author: Elizabeth A

title: Beautiful Gothic architecture
text: If you're planning to visit Casa Batlló, Casa Amatller is just next door and although it isn't by Gaudi, this modernist architecture was truly amazing with hints of gothic styles. It was absolutely breathtaking and worth the visit!
author: ncavien

title: Quieter and quieter walk to do
text: I liked it a lot, it is a much quieter walk than the other houses, the guide goes with vc on all floors and goes explaining all points, but the languages available are Spanish, Catalao and English only. My ticket gave me the right to a coffee at the end that was super worth it. The architecture of the house is pretty and peculiar, reminds a little of the houses of the historic cities of Brazil. It has air conditioning, which saves in the summer heat.
